description:
## What

Multipurpose-generation sibling to `SmimeIndividualValidated`
(Individual Strict, shipped via PKIX-jbvb.7). Per CA/B Forum S/MIME BR
§7.1.6.1: Multipurpose certs assert policy OID `2.23.140.1.5.4.2` and
permit additional EKU values beyond `emailProtection`.

Not blocked — Individual Strict is shipped. Structural template is in
`pkix-profiles-cabf/src/lib.rs` `SmimeIndividualValidated`.

## API shape

```rust
pub struct SmimeIndividualValidatedMultipurpose;

impl Profile for SmimeIndividualValidatedMultipurpose {
    fn id(&self) -> &'static str { "cabf.smime.individual.multipurpose" }
    fn version(&self) -> &'static str { "1.0.14" }
    fn policy(&self, now_unix: u64) -> ValidationPolicy {
        // Baseline same as SmimeIndividualValidated (Strict), with:
        // - required_leaf_policy_oids: [2.23.140.1.5.4.2]
        // - EKU permissiveness per §7.1.2.3(f) Multipurpose row
        // - same DN rule: (givenName ∧ surname) ∨ pseudonym
        //   per §7.1.4.2.6 Note 2
    }
}

pub const fn smime_individual_multipurpose_policy(now_unix: u64) -> ValidationPolicy { ... }
```

## Subject DN rule

Per §7.1.4.2.6 Multipurpose column: identical to Strict. Reuse the
same `DnAttrRule` construction as `SmimeIndividualValidated`.

## OID constant

Add `CABF_SMIME_INDIVIDUAL_VALIDATED_MULTIPURPOSE_POLICY` =
`ObjectIdentifier::new_unwrap("2.23.140.1.5.4.2")`.

## Test fixture

Generate `smime-individual-multipurpose-self-signed-365d.der` and
`smime-individual-multipurpose-pseudonym-self-signed-365d.der` via
extension to `gen-smime-tier-fixtures.py`. Two-form pattern matching
Individual Strict.

## Acceptance

- Type, alias, OID constant ship.
- 2 positive fixtures.
- Negative: cross-tier OID mismatches fail correctly.
- CHANGELOG + divergences.md updated.
- Same clippy/fmt/test bars as PKIX-jbvb.9.2.

## Not blocked

Individual Strict (PKIX-jbvb.7) is shipped. Autonomous-loop-claimable
when epic priority surfaces it.
